introHtml: Wheat straw lunch bags, boxes, and totes offer a sustainable alternative to traditional plastics, made from agricultural byproducts that would otherwise be discarded. These eco-friendly items are lightweight yet sturdy, ideal for corporate giveaways, trade shows, or employee appreciation. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or debossing for a natural look that aligns with green initiatives.
